keyword.zh: 柴油120和LZ-80混凝土泵的区别

title.zh: 柴油120和LZ-80混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: Diesel 120 prints 100 m³/h from two 145 kW units. LZ-80 prints a Yuchai 256 kW engine and two pressure ceilings.
description.zh: 柴油120印两台 145 kW、合计产量 100 m³/h。LZ-80 印玉柴 256 kW，并有两档压力上限。

h1.zh: 柴油120和LZ-80混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Diesel 120 and LZ-80 are high-output diesel concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Diesel 120 prints 290 kW as two 145 kW units, 100 m³/h, 40 MPa and distance 150 m / 500 m. LZ-80 prints 256 kW (Yuchai), high pressure ≤ 65 m³/h at ≤ 35 MPa, and low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h at ≤ 22 MPa. Both print aggregate 6 cm and below and a 0.6 m³ hopper.
directAnswer.zh: 柴油120和 LZ-80 是河北品锦机械在邢台的大排量柴油混凝土泵。柴油120印 290 kW（两台 145 kW）、100 m³/h、40 MPa、距离 150 m / 500 m。LZ-80 印 256 kW（玉柴），高压 ≤ 65 m³/h、≤ 35 MPa，低压 ≤ 95 m³/h、≤ 22 MPa。骨料都是 6 cm 及以下，料斗都是 0.6 m³。LZ-80 的高度格写的是咨询工厂标准。

heading.en: Where Diesel 120 and LZ-80 print different values

body.en: Theoretical output: Diesel 120 prints 100 m³/h; LZ-80 prints High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h. Hydraulic pump: Diesel 120 prints Kawasaki 112 (two units); LZ-80 prints Kawasaki double 140. Dimensions: Diesel 120 prints 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm; LZ-80 prints 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. The same printed value on a shared label: Hopper capacity is 0.6 m³ on both pages; Max. aggregate size is 6 cm and below on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 理论输送量：柴油120印 100 m³/h；LZ-80印 High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h。液压泵：柴油120印 Kawasaki 112 (two units)；LZ-80印 Kawasaki double 140。外形尺寸：柴油120印 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm；LZ-80印 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。同一标题下数值相同的有：料斗容积两边都是 0.6 m³；最大骨料粒径两边都是 6 cm and below。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Diesel 120 prints cells that LZ-80 does not: Diesel engine power 290 kW (two units 145 kW); Max. outlet pressure 40 MPa; Conveying distance (H / V) 150 m / 500 m; Main unit weight 8000 kg. LZ-80 prints cells that Diesel 120 does not: Engine (diesel) 256 kW (Yuchai); Pumping pressure High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa; Conveying distance 120 m; Delivery height Consult factory standard; Total weight 6800 kg. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 柴油120有、LZ-80没有的行：柴油机功率 290 kW (two units 145 kW)；最大出口压力 40 MPa；输送距离（水平/垂直） 150 m / 500 m；整机重量 8000 kg。LZ-80有、柴油120没有的行：柴油发动机 256 kW (Yuchai)；泵送压力 High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa；输送距离 120 m；输送高度 Consult factory standard；整机重量 6800 kg。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: Two large diesel rows still use different output notation: one figure versus a high and low ceiling. Open /en/products/diesel-120-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 120 and /en/products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump/ for LZ-80. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 两台大型柴油泵的产量写法仍不同：一个数字，对上一高一低两档上限。看柴油120请打开 /zh/products/diesel-120-concrete-pump/，看LZ-80请打开 /zh/products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Diesel 120 print the same theoretical output as LZ-80?
question.zh: 柴油120和LZ-80的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 120 prints 100 m³/h. LZ-80 prints High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油120印 100 m³/h。LZ-80印 High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Diesel 120 print the same hydraulic pump as LZ-80?
question.zh: 柴油120和LZ-80的液压泵一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 120 prints Kawasaki 112 (two units). LZ-80 prints Kawasaki double 140. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油120印 Kawasaki 112 (two units)。LZ-80印 Kawasaki double 140。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Diesel 120 print the same dimensions as LZ-80?
question.zh: 柴油120和LZ-80的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 120 prints 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm. LZ-80 prints 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油120印 7000 × 2000 × 2300 mm。LZ-80印 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is diesel engine power missing on LZ-80?
question.zh: 为什么LZ-80没有柴油机功率？

answer.en: The LZ-80 page does not print that label. Diesel 120 prints 290 kW (two units 145 kW). Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: LZ-80这一页没有印这个标题。柴油120印的是 290 kW (two units 145 kW)。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
